routines.name: Full Body Reset
routines.focus: A balanced pass from neck to ankles

poses.name: Neck Rolls
poses.cue: Slow half circles, chin toward the chest, never rolling backwards.

poses.name: Shoulder Opener
poses.cue: Clasp hands behind the back, lift gently and keep the ribs down.

poses.name: Standing Forward Fold
poses.cue: Soft knees. Let the head hang and breathe into the hamstrings.

poses.name: Low Lunge, Left
poses.cue: Back knee down, hips press forward, chest tall.

poses.name: Low Lunge, Right
poses.cue: Same on the other side. Keep the front knee over the ankle.

poses.name: Seated Twist
poses.cue: Lengthen the spine first, then rotate. Both sides.

poses.name: Figure Four
poses.cue: Ankle over the opposite knee, draw the thigh in. Both sides.

poses.name: Calf Stretch
poses.cue: Heel down, back leg straight, lean into a wall.

poses.name: Child's Pose
poses.cue: Knees wide, arms long, forehead resting. Slow exhale.

routines.name: Legs & Hips
routines.focus: For after running or a heavy leg session

poses.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
poses.cue: Tuck the pelvis under before leaning forward. Both sides.

poses.name: Hamstring Reach
poses.cue: One leg extended, hinge from the hip, spine long. Both sides.

poses.name: Quad Pull
poses.cue: Knees together, heel to glute, push the hip forward. Both sides.

poses.name: Butterfly
poses.cue: Soles together, let the knees fall. Never bounce.

poses.name: Pigeon
poses.cue: Front shin angled, hips square, sink slowly. Both sides.

poses.name: Calf & Achilles
poses.cue: Straight leg first, then a bent knee for the lower calf.

poses.name: Lying Hamstring
poses.cue: Strap or hands behind the thigh, leg as straight as it allows.

poses.name: Supine Twist
poses.cue: Knees drop to one side, shoulders stay down. Both sides.

routines.name: Back & Shoulders
routines.focus: Undo a day at a desk

poses.name: Cat and Cow
poses.cue: Move with the breath, one vertebra at a time.

poses.name: Thread the Needle
poses.cue: Arm slides under the body, shoulder to the mat. Both sides.

poses.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
poses.cue: Forearm on the frame, step through until the chest opens.

poses.name: Triceps Overhead
poses.cue: Elbow up, gently guide it back. Both sides.

poses.name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
poses.cue: Palm up, fingers back. Essential if you lift or climb.

poses.name: Thoracic Extension
poses.cue: Upper back over a rolled towel, arms overhead.

poses.name: Neck Side Bend
poses.cue: Ear toward the shoulder, opposite hand reaching down.

poses.name: Puppy Pose
poses.cue: Hips over knees, chest melts toward the floor.
